scientific_integrity: Full analytic proof presented; finite numerical verification is supporting evidence, not an infinite proof. Published general principles and the source block/spectral formulas are credited.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the exact stationary VBP splitting with symmetric indefinite W and SPD T, not the outer FGMRES solver, finite-step norm minimization, inexact solves or floating-point stability. The 2024 PMBP paper was accessible only through its abstract and a distinct preconditioner family, leaving residual originality risk.
title: Unique rate-optimal shift for the VBP stationary iteration
